title: Words Matter: Reducing Stigma in Online Conversations about Substance Use with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing online Reddit discussions for stigmatizing language (labeling, stereotyping, separation, status loss, and discrimination) directed at people who use substances (PWUS) using LLMs, topic modeling, and emotion classification. The study also evaluates LLM-generated de-stigmatized text using human evaluation (for naturalness, appropriateness, faithfulness, and extent of de-stigmatization) and automatic linguistic analysis (LIWC).
